judged_text: The migration dereferences execute(...)[0]['id'] on the embed_category lookup without checking for an empty result, so it raises NoMethodError on nil whenever no site_settings row named 'embed_category' exists, and the uncategorized_category_id fallback on line 15 repeats the same unguarded [0] access. db:migrate aborts during deploy for every fresh install and every site that never overrode embed_category (setting defaults are not materialized as site_settings rows), rolling back the new table and blocking the release; the guarded cmd_tuples check on the embeddable_hosts query three lines below shows the empty-result case was anticipated there but not here.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id']` for the `embed_category` lookup and later `execute(...)[0]['value']` for `uncategorized_category_id` without checking whether the query returned any rows. If the `site_settings` table has no row for `embed_category` (likely when defaults aren’t materialized), `execute(...)[0]` will be nil and `['id']` will raise, aborting the migration. This is consistent with the later guarded `cmd_tuples` check used for `embeddable_hosts`, showing the empty-result case is expected elsewhere but not handled here.
